verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop app that runs a coding agent on your own projects. The agent can commit, push and open pull requests, but nothing in the evidence shows a cloud-hosted agent that builds, tests and demos a feature end-to-end for review. Local PR creation is an adjacent capability, not a cloud agent, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review
